check: (kube_job_failed{namespace=~@namespace,job_name=~"factory-semgrep-sync-[0-9]+",condition="true"} and on (namespace, job_name) (kube_job_status_start_time == on (namespace) group_left max by (namespace) (kube_job_status_start_time{namespace=~@namespace,job_name=~"factory-semgrep-sync-[0-9]+"}))) or on (namespace) (0 * max by (namespace) (kube_job_status_start_time{namespace=~@namespace,job_name=~"factory-semgrep-sync-[0-9]+"}))
steps:
The check shows the newest sync in this namespace. The graph shows the Job that triggered this link. For a failed check, use its job_name and namespace to inspect the logs:

kubectl -n <namespace> logs job/<job_name>
